_comment: Per-template fill rules for fill-gate-template.mjs. Each entry names the source template file (relative to sprints/04_RUNBOOKS/), the CLI flags required to fill it, and the placeholder-token -> flag-name map used for substitution. Only the placeholders listed here are ever touched — a template's Forbidden and Report sections are copied through verbatim from the source file, including any placeholder tokens they still contain (e.g. '<ANYTHING ELSE THIS COMMIT SHOULD NOT TOUCH>', '<NEXT_GATE_ID>'), since fill-gate-template.mjs does not fill those.
